description: Create pacman_parser.py with parse_si_output, parse_qi_output, parse_qq_output functions. Pure Python, no Qt, no subprocess. Handles multi-value fields (Depends On, Required By, Groups, Replaces, Conflicts With, Provides, Optdepends) as lists. Parsing rule: records separated by blank lines, each line is 'Key           : value', multi-value fields split on two spaces or contain 'None'. Add tests/fixtures/pacman/{si_output.txt,qi_output.txt,qq_output.txt} with realistic multi-package output, and tests/core/test_pacman_parser.py verifying all three parsers handle multi-value fields correctly.
steps: Create src/aurelis_software/core/pacman_parser.py with parse_si_output(text) -> list[dict], parse_qi_output(text) -> list[dict], parse_qq_output(text) -> list[str]. Each record is separated by blank lines. Lines are 'Key           : value'. Multi-value fields: split on '  ' (two spaces) or skip if value is 'None'. Return list of dicts with keys matching pacman field names (lowercase with underscores: depends_on, required_by, groups, etc.).

Create tests/fixtures/pacman/ directory and add si_output.txt (5+ packages from pacman -Si, including one with multi-value Depends On and Groups), qi_output.txt (3+ installed packages from pacman -Qi with Required By field), qq_output.txt (10+ package names, one per line).

Create tests/core/test_pacman_parser.py with test_parse_si_handles_multi_value_fields, test_parse_qi_output, test_parse_qq_output, test_parse_si_handles_blank_lines_separator, test_parse_qi_handles_none_value. Use the fixture files. Assert on record count, field types, and multi-value list contents.
acceptance_criteria: parse_si_output returns list[dict] with one dict per package
parse_qi_output returns list[dict] with installed package fields including required_by
parse_qq_output returns list[str] with one package name per line
Multi-value fields (depends_on, groups, required_by, etc.) are returned as lists, not strings
Empty or 'None' multi-value fields return empty lists
verification: Run pytest tests/core/test_pacman_parser.py -v and confirm all tests pass
Run ./check and confirm 0 ruff violations and all tests pass
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Parser correctly handles multi-value fields as lists, blank line separators, and 'None' values. All tests pass including edge cases for empty input.
